events.title: Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album "Imagine" was released in 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: More than five decades on, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album remains a powerful call for peace and unity. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: British musician, singer, and songwriter Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Sting! From The Police frontman to a stellar solo career, his distinctive sound has spanned decades. What's your favourite Sting or Police track?

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the Original iPod
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How did it change the way you listened to music?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the enduring film franchise, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, "Dr. No", on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Don't mention the war!', which of his unforgettable characters always makes you laugh?

events.title: White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, often called "The White Album," was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your favourite track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. Considered a masterpiece, what's your favourite track from this iconic album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: John Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. Share a memory or a favourite song.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The influential British musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Starman
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie, a true innovator, whose music continues to inspire. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday The King
angles.copy: Long live The King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music changed the world. What's the first Elvis song that comes to mind?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the guitar god, Jimmy Page! From his iconic riffs with Led Zeppelin to his legendary production, he's a true rock pioneer. What's your favourite Page moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! That distinctive voice has given us so many hits across the decades. Which one is your favourite?
